title: One Basket, Many Experts: Decorrelated Re-ranking for Financial Asset Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial asset recommendation for retail investors is typically optimized for relevance, that is, how well a recommendation matches what each user will buy. From the service provider's point of view, the value of a recommendation also depends on portfolio performance: the risk-adjusted return the recommended assets (the basket) deliver, which drives user engagement and fee revenue. The two goals are rarely achieved jointly, because the recommendations that best match user behavior concentrate on a few popular assets whose returns are highly correlated, which caps the risk-adjusted return a provider can offer. We propose Decorrelated-Satellite Expert Re-ranking (\textbf{DSER}), which retains the most relevant recommendations from an expert-following list and replaces the rest with return-decorrelated alternatives. The number of replaced slots is a single integer~$m$ (a knob) that the provider sets, so the relevance--performance trade-off

translated_title: 一篮子多专家：面向金融资产推荐的去相关重排序方法
translated_abstract: 针对散户投资者的金融资产推荐通常以相关性为优化目标，即推荐结果与每位用户实际购买行为的匹配程度。而从服务提供商的角度来看，推荐的价值还取决于投资组合的表现：即所推荐资产（投资篮子）所带来的风险调整后收益，这直接驱动用户参与度和费用收入。这两个目标很少能同时实现，因为最匹配用户行为的推荐往往集中在少数热门资产上，而这些资产的收益高度相关，从而限制了提供商所能提供的风险调整后收益上限。我们提出了去相关卫星专家重排序方法（DSER），该方法保留专家跟踪列表中最相关的推荐，并用收益去相关的替代资产替换其余推荐。被替换的槽位数量是一个由提供商设定的单一整数 m（一个可调节的旋钮），因此相关性与绩效之间的权衡……
tldr: 提出DSER重排序方法，通过用收益去相关的替代资产替换专家推荐列表中的部分内容，并借助单一可调参数m，在用户相关性与投资组合风险调整后收益之间实现灵活权衡。
en_tdlr: Proposes DSER, a re-ranking method that replaces part of an expert-following recommendation list with return-decorrelated alternatives via a single tunable integer m, balancing user relevance against portfolio risk-adjusted returns.
